notes.title: Update #15 BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello Commander,

We have read all the reviews and feedback, and it filled our hearts with joy to see we managed to make so many of you happy.

 Because of this, we have made an important decision.

The new extra content of the game will not be released as a DLC.
Why?
I don't think it's fair to have the initial players who supported our game during the most critical game release phase to have to pay again.

We also don't want to raise the game price because we want this game to be as accessible as possible to everyone.

So we decided that the new extra content will be released for FREE as part of the main version updates.


New roadmap commander:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/d91e1efdcd26205e42e3dbd7cdc1b0554874f54c.png

How are we going to cut our losses?
Our losses are our own and it is not your responsibility to help us out.
So this is how we will do it:
We will release a very expensive 20$-25$ DLC in the form of an artbook, I will tell you by now, 20$ for an artbook is not worth it, and this is why this artbook will be TOTALLY OPTIONAL, it wont bring any value tot he actual game and it is simbolical only for the ones of you who still want to support our studio, think of this DLC as a sort of optional donation. No strains attached.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now, on to the juicy part.
UPDATE TIME.

We added a lot of stuff that will test your tactical and survival abilities to the max.


Bug Fixes:
- Cannot see the interface because the unit panel does not disappear after I exit skilldex and crafting
- Unit with rifle cannot change it for sniper and LMG (normal 7.7mm weapon pool) 
- Plant killing achievement not working
- CRASH: game crashed when pressing "next" button from the ending movie fast
- BUG: units have strange animation when switching weapons, this also happens after interaction 
- Grenade launched shooting on the opposite side
- Turret upgrade on engineer shows +2Range +1Damage but in the stats bar it shows +Accuracy and +Range.
- The extraction grade does not match the spec bubble line from the ending movie
- Some units have the wrong loadout
- Steam achievement "Kill Destroy 100 infected." is not working


Ballance:
- Engineers encounter range cost,  from 40 to 150
- Mission A and Mission B from end DEFCON 4, that vision custom reduced by 50%
- added final weapon balance(more firepower to some upgrades)
- added final balance for food cost per unit per day for each difficulty setting
- added re-ballance HP growth each defcon for all infected
- added re-ballance HP growth each defcon for tentacles(aggro 5 will now be a LOT more dangerous)
- added an additional 1 hunger penalty to the map: police station from DEFCON 4
- added an additional 1 hunger penalty to the map: tin can factory from DEFCON 4
- added + 1 AGGRO after extraction TD mission
- added + 1 hunger penalty after extraction TD mission


Extra content:
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 5 (fast reward or long term reward)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 4 (reward vs penalty)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 3 (big penalty to one vs small penalty to all)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 2 (sacrifice epic moment)
- 1 new morning event for DEFCON 1 (pay or support the consequences)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/45b523007cb2e7c7e0a95ab2f326715acca0f180.png


Because we added so much new stuff, some new bugs may appear, but don't be afraid, we are here and we will crush all reported bugs.


This been said, we invite you all to our Discord community if you want to live chat with us, we are never too busy or too arrogant not to talk to our fans.



Soon we will also make an announcement about the future of our studio.










Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Update #6 BIG CONTENT
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders,





Good news or bad news first ?

So let's start with our situation Update, the bad news first.



The release results are far below our expectations.

But even though we received so little support, that little support was AWESOME, we noticed players who already finished the game 7 or 8 times in the first week of release, seeing you so invested in our humble creation with your stories on our Discord made our hearts grow, and for you, FOR YOU we dedicate this EXTRA content update!

I don't know how other indie developers are but for us, the situation is as follows:

Do you enjoy our humble creation? = We will eat that motivation on naked bread and push a stellar effort to make a bit more extra content.
We make money from our humble creation? = We will add more content with a more professional pipeline perspective, not very motivating to the heart but it pays the bills and at the end of day this is very important.
You don't like our humble creation? = We respect your opinion, we will try better next time and if possible we will try to improve it in the limit of funding but eventually, we cannot spend huge time working on something that "might" be good so we need to know when to cut our losses and move on.
Surely this does not mean we won't fix the bugs & maintenance.
 We care  about our brand and no matter the outcome we will provide full professional support in fixing all critical bugs.
We like to be fully transparent with our audience.

Roadmap Update 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055019/764f7b4ed75a16c26bcbb44378487f39457eb017.png



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update #6


UPDATE TIME

Ballance:
- we made the apartment encounter give 2 hunger feed instead of one to better balance the new hunger mechanic
- we added different hunger  more gameplay time + replaibility
- more common components in order to better balance the components(yes, we noticed many of you had a lot of rare and legendary components but very little common components so we decided to go big and try to balance them via environment map design not trough just changing numbers)
- secret hidden 40mm because we noticed some of you asked to find more 40mm, well now we made such a design that we have 40mm in almost all new maps but they are mostly all hidden in secret place for you to discover)

02. Greenhouse - DEFCON 5
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- easy way to learn about Network object mechanics 
- More Blood sample data quest progress because we noticed that blood sample data progress from the game is at the limit and many reached the ending without having this side quest complete
- more common components in order to better balance the components

03. Back Alley - DEFCON 4
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- we thought about bringing a fresh type of gameplay approach, this map is not focused on a defensive approach but rather focused on aggressive gameplay, you need to push forward in the back alley of the city to find your way out before to many infected swarms your strike team
- more common components in order to better balance the components

04. Grocery Shop - DEFCON 4
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- more common components in order to better balance the components
- more food + hunger feed objects in order to better balance the new food mechanic
- more challenging map design with 2 entrance points 

05. Back Alley 2 - DEFCON 2
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- we thought about bringing a fresh type of gameplay approach, this map is not focused on a defensive approach but rather focused on aggressive gameplay, you need to push forward in the back alley of the city to find your way out before to many infected swarms your strike team
- more common components in order to better balance the components
- Interesting spot to make quick path decision

06. Streets  - DEFCON 2
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- cola machines to better balance hunger stats
- biggest map the game engine can handle, its huge
- push forward & don't look back type of gameplay/objective

07. Lab 3 - DEFCON 1
- increase map pool > more gameplay time + replaibility
- new approach, defend + push forward type of gameplay
- balance better a final chance at having more blood sample data quest
- connecting with Chromosome Evil 1 lore 


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What will happen next?

This month we will be focusing on fixing bugs because surely such a huge update will generate some new bugs.
So if you encounter bugs, don't be afraid, do not panic, we are here, tell us how to reproduce and we will fix.

Also this month the second focus will be to polish the game balance.

At the end of this month, the game will be at this point at 101% from all points of view.
And after this month ends we will only provide bug fixing in case we missed any critical bugs and reports that come later.


There is also a small possibility that we might release a Map Editor DLC in the future or some content DLC but these are conditioned by how the game performs on Steam so we will not make any kind of promises in this regard.



As for our studio's future, we don't know yet, we might quit game dev and return to our day job or we might take our chances for one more small project.
We will make a public announcement in this regard soon.

If you want to live chat with us, you are all invited to our Discord, we are never too busy or too arrogant to not chat with our fans.
Invitation Link: https://discord.gg/ak5zXQxR7D





CALL TO ACTION
Share the news about our humble creation on social media, with your friends, its the best you can do.








Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Update #5

Hello Commander,

- for the health skill we added additional 5 HP points per level
- level up XP cap per level re-balanced better

What's next?
We have not reached any of our release milestones but we still want to push a content updated with additional maps. 
Why?
Because even though the ones that supported the game release are very few they are freaking awesome and the next update is for YOU!




Good luck Commander!
